verdict: Organic visibility is dropping across all three locations; blockers are being cleared.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, Google Business Profile and organic search are the only active channels this period — and both are under pressure. Combined GBP actions totalled 381 over the last 28 days, but all three locations saw engagement fall in the most recent 7 days, with Forte and O'Hare showing the steepest drops. Simultaneously, search clicks declined sharply across locations, and the pattern — GBP and organic search falling together — points to a listing or indexing issue rather than seasonality alone; a fix has been identified and submitted. Several CRM and outreach milestones that gate downstream pipeline activity are overdue, and resolving those is the immediate priority so that contact sequences and data integrity work can move forward on schedule.

watch_item.issue: GBP actions and search clicks are both declining simultaneously across all three locations, with several days of zero activity in the most recent stretch — a signal that points to a listing or indexing issue.
watch_item.fix: A root-cause fix has been identified and submitted for the web and SEO issue; site reindexing is targeted for completion by end of October, and overdue CRM and outreach blockers are being resolved now to open the downstream pipeline.
